from pathlib import Path
p = Path('Makefile')
text = p.read_text()
old_jobs = 'HOST_BUILD_JOBS ?= 2'
new_jobs = 'HOST_BUILD_JOBS ?= 4'
old_run = 'RUN_IDF := bash scripts/run_idf.sh\n'
cache_block = 'IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE ?= 1\nexport IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE\n'
if old_jobs in text:
    text = text.replace(old_jobs, new_jobs, 1)
elif new_jobs not in text:
    raise SystemExit('HOST_BUILD_JOBS line not found')
if cache_block not in text:
    if text.count(old_run) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'expected one RUN_IDF line, found {text.count(old_run)}')
    text = text.replace(old_run, old_run + cache_block, 1)
p.write_text(text)
PY
